statement: Use Proposition 4.3 with p = 1, so α = 1/2. Fix C0 > 0. There is a constant C1, depending only on q, R, J, ∆, C0, with the following property for every real n ≥ 2 and every nonempty S0 ⊆ Λ with |S0| ≤ C0n2. Put r0 = ⌈C1(log n)2⌉. If d0 i := dΛ(ai, S0) < ∞, define ri = max{r0, ⌊d0 i /2⌋}, ˜︁ hi = ki,ri , ˜︁ Xi = Nri (ai). (4.16) If d0 i = ∞, set ˜︁ hi = ki and designate its anchor’s entire component as ˜︁ Xi. Then ˜︁ H = ∑︁ i ˜︁ hi is a sum of positive contractions and ∥ ˜︁ H − HF ∥ ≤ ϵn, ϵn := min{n−1000 , g/4}. (4.17) 22 Its ground energy ˜︁ E0 lies in [0, ϵn], its ground vector ˜︁ Ω is unique, and its gap is at least g/2. After a choice of phase, ∥˜︁ Ω − Ω∥ ≤ 2 √︂ ϵn/g, 1 2 ⃦ ⃦|˜︁ Ω⟩⟨˜︁ Ω| − PΩ ⃦ ⃦ 1 ≤ √︂ 2ϵn/g. (4.18) For a set X ⊆ S0, let bX = |∂ΛX| and let CX be the labels whose designated supports ˜︁ Xi meet both X and Λ \ X. Every such support has radius exactly r0, and |CX| ≤ CbX(r0 + 1)2 , log di ≤ C(r0 + 1)2 (i ∈ CX), di := q| ˜︁ Xi| . (4.19) Consequently the cut parameter BX := 1 + ∑︂ i∈CX log2 (edi) ≤ C(1 + bX)(r0 + 1)6 . (4.20) In particular, bX ≤ C2nD and D ≥ 1 imply BX ≤ CnD(log n)12, with the constant also depending on C2.
